caption:
When you are building something sacred, silence becomes your shield 
#usahealth #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind
transcript: When you are building something sacred, silence becomes your shield. You are buying a home. Stay quiet. You are preparing to buy a car. Stay quiet. You are planning a journey. Stay quiet. A new degree is coming. Stay quiet. A promotion arrives. Stay quiet. You found a good man or a good woman. Stay quiet, not out of fear. But because not every soul knows how to hold your joy with gentle hands, most dreams break before they bloom, because we spoke too early to the wrong people at the wrong moment and their doubt touched our seed before it had roots. Protect your path, my friend. Move in silence. Grow in silence. Let your success speak when the time is right. If this touched your spirit, if it reminded you of something you forgot, comment, Peace, so I know you are still fighting for your peace.
